ns2:course.label: Constr Matls Characterization
ns2:course.description: Laboratory methods such as thermal analysis, optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and x-ray diffraction used to characterize civil engineering materials. Theoretical background, calculation methods, models, underlying assumptions, and operation of the instrument are examined for each method. Prerequisite: CEE 300; one of CEE 401, CEE 405, CEE 483.
